pages: Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, writes on one return sheet at a table in the ship's lounge with a pencil. Middle distance: a rolled chart under the table edge, a mug, a window blind. Background: the lounge window, grey sea, early morning.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, stands beside one corner post at the top of the marked ground on a steep peat slope. Middle distance: burrow holes in the peat, a marker flag, tussock grass. Background: the slope falling to a white sea, low sun.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, kneels on the slope and looks down one hole with a mirror on a long pole. Middle distance: a spade, a torch, more burrow mouths. Background: the slope rising above her, grey cloud, cold white daylight.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, writes in one rain-darkened field book on her knees in the rain. Middle distance: burrow holes, a thermos, wet tussock. Background: the slope and a low grey sea, rain across it.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, crouches at the foot of the slope beside one burrow with a fresh side entrance. Middle distance: a ledge of black rock, streaks of white guano, a marker flag. Background: rock and surf at the shore, flat light.

Colin Meikle, a man of seventy-four, white hair, a grey wool jumper and a blue windproof vest, turns one knob on a black field radio in the hut. Middle distance: a walking frame by the door, a flask on the table, a barometer on the wall. Background: the hut window, grey daylight on the slope outside.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, holds one field book open at a ruled series of numbers on the slope. Middle distance: a pencil behind her ear, burrow holes, wet tussock. Background: the slope above the harbour, grey sea, low sun.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, stands at the top of the marked ground holding one snapped guy wire. Middle distance: two fallen posts on their sides, heaps of spoil, bare grey rock. Background: the slip face and the sea, flat overcast light.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, kneels at the edge of the slip with one hand on a broken corner post lying in the spoil. Middle distance: a grey clay cut, marker flags, burrow holes. Background: the clay channel down to the water.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, sits at a kitchen table with one field book open before her and squared sheets beside it. Middle distance: a mug, a pencil, a window ledge. Background: a plain room, low evening light.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, stands at the top of the slope with one field book open, looking down the seaward hundred metres. Middle distance: the slip edge, burrow holes below, a marker flag. Background: the harbour, a grey ocean, low sun.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, leans over one aerial photograph on a light table. Middle distance: a steel ruler, a pair of dividers, her field book. Background: an office wall, a window, flat daylight.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, stands at a wire fence above the harbour with one closed notebook in her hand, looking down the slope. Middle distance: slack fence wire, wind-bent grass, tussock. Background: the seabird slope and a grey ocean, low sun.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, stands on the deck of the supply ship looking up at one helicopter. Middle distance: a coiled mooring line, a life ring, a rail stanchion. Background: the island ridgeline and the sea, low sun.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, kneels at one corner pin of a newly flagged square of ground on the bench above. Middle distance: orange flagging tape, a tape measure, burrow mouths. Background: the slope below and the grey sea, overcast light.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, works a division out in the margin of one field book at a table in the hut. Middle distance: a pencil, a thermos, a folded chart. Background: rain on the hut window, flat grey light.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, drives one digging spade into the peat on the slope. Middle distance: a heap of spoil, a marker flag, an opened burrow. Background: the slope above the harbour, grey daylight.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, kneels beside one opened burrow where a peat wall stands across the middle. Middle distance: a heap of spoil, the spade, a marker flag. Background: the peat bank and a strip of sea, flat light.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, signs one return sheet at the lounge table with a fountain pen. Middle distance: her field book, a mug, a rolled chart. Background: the lounge window, the sea, low evening sun.

Miri Mahuru, a woman of nineteen, black hair tied back, a red waterproof jacket over a grey jumper, black trousers, gumboots, climbs the slope holding one cut-off length of guy wire. Middle distance: a lone corner post standing, a grey clay channel, her spade. Background: the ridge in evening light, the sea beyond.
